cards.title: Rounding down
cards.body: `/` gives a decimal: `7 / 2` is `3.5`. `Math.floor()` rounds down to the whole number below.

hi.title: Neeche round karna
hi.body: `/` decimal deta hai: `7 / 2` ka matlab `3.5`. `Math.floor()` neeche wale whole number tak round karta hai.

cards.title: The remainder %
cards.body: `%` gives what is left over after dividing. 17 split into groups of 5 leaves 2.

hi.title: Remainder %
hi.body: `%` batata hai divide karne ke baad kitna bacha. 17 ko 5-5 ke groups mein baanto toh 2 bachte hain.

cards.title: Printing several values
cards.body: Give `console.log()` several values separated by commas and it prints them with one space between each.

hi.title: Kai values print karna
hi.body: `console.log()` ko commas se alag karke kai values do, woh unhe beech mein ek space ke saath print karta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: For 150 seconds it should print `2 30`, but it prints `2.5 30`. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: `total / 60` keeps the decimals. Round down with `Math.floor(total / 60)`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: 150 seconds ke liye isse `2 30` print karna chahiye, par yeh `2.5 30` print karta hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: `total / 60` decimals rakhta hai. `Math.floor(total / 60)` se neeche round karo.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: 100 / 60 rounds down to 1 whole minute, and 100 % 60 is the 40 seconds left over.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: 100 / 60 neeche round hokar 1 poora minute banta hai, aur 100 % 60 bache hue 40 seconds hain.

exercise.prompt: Read a number of seconds and print it as `M min S s`. For `135`, print `2 min 15 s`
exercise.promptHi: Seconds ki ek sankhya padho aur use `M min S s` ki tarah print karo. `135` ke liye `2 min 15 s` print karo.
